artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as the primary artifact. The 'texture_anomaly' on click wheel labels (severity 2.0) is also valid—the OCR confidence scores (<0.65 for most blocks) confirm the text is deformed/hallucinated rather than crisp print. The 'perspective_distortion' (severity 1.5) is subtle but supported by the topology mask showing slight edge irregularities. The Perceptual Quality Auditor's 'null' finding is misleading here; it missed the semantic artifact of gibberish text because it only looks for graphic distortions like blur/noise. I maintain the Router's artifact findings as they are more specific to the object's function.
alignment_reasoning: The fine_grained_classifier strongly confirms the class 'iPod' (logit 7.37 vs 3.12 for next best), ensuring high structural alignment. 6 out of 7 testable checkpoints passed.
